articles.summary: LATAM Airlines Group S.A. (LATAM or the Company) (SSE: LTM / NYSE: LTM) along with its consolidated affiliates (LATAM group), the leading airline group in Latin America, announces that it will release its financial results for the first quarter 2026 on May 5, 2026, following the market close. The release will be available on the Companys Investor Relations website: ir.latam.com . The Company will hold a conference call to discuss the first quarter 2026 financial results on May 6, 2026, at 8:00 am ET / Santiago. Adhering to good corporate governance practices, the Company will begin its quiet period on April 21, 2026, ending immediately after the release of the financial results on May 5, 2026. articles.summary: - LATAM Airlines Group S.A. (LATAM Airlines Group or the "Company) (NYSE: LTM / SSE: LTM) and its affiliates, the leading airline group in South America, announces the publication of its 2025 Annual Integrated Report in English and Spanish. The 2025 Annual Integrated Report highlights LATAM groups key milestones throughout the year, including solid financial performance, the continued execution of its profitable growth strategy and initiatives aimed at enhancing both the customer and employee experience, alongside progress in environmental, social, and governance (ESG) dimensions. It captures how the group is advancing with purpose, creating opportunities and value for its customers, employees, and the environment. The document in Spanish is available on the website of the Financial Market Commission at www.cmfchile.cl or on the Companys Investor Relations website at ir.latam.com in both languages.
